actions.action: Check soil moisture 2 inches down before watering
Water thoroughly until it drains when dry
Empty standing water from outer decorative pot after watering
Move plant to brighter indirect light away from heaters, vents and AC
Trim fully yellow or brown fronds at the base
If soil stays wet or stems turn soft/black, post follow-up with photos of plant base

reason: The answer blames relocation stress and watering, mentioning light only as part of the move; the brighter-light fix appears as one step among several, and nothing it recommends is harmful.
